title: Measure streaming latency and an on-device budget
brief: Compute RTF, the delay of each position in a chunk, first-partial and final latency from a timeline, the unstable-prefix rate, and whether a quantized model fits a device.
hints: rtf is compute_seconds / audio_seconds. 3 s of compute for 10 s of audio is 0.3.
Position p in a chunk of C frames with L look-ahead frames waits (C - p + L) hops. C=4, L=2, 40 ms gives 240, 200, 160, 120 ms.
A latency is an event time minus the time the word ended. With word ends [480, 640, 760, 1240], a first partial at 560 ms has latency 560 - 480 = 80 ms, not 560 ms.
For each partial, count the words before the first word that differs from the final. The rest are unstable. ['turn on a'] against 'turn on the lights' has 3 words shown and 1 unstable.
model_bytes is ceil(params * bits / 8). 30 million parameters at 8 bits is 30,000,000 bytes. fits_on_device adds the chunk activations and uses <= against the budget.
